name: Booking Master
author: CodeYatri

sections.description:
Booking Master is designed for professionals who need a simple yet powerful way to manage their appointments. Unlike bloated booking plugins, Booking Master focuses on a “Type-First” approach, similar to services like Calendly.

Key Features

  • Event-Based Architecture: Create different types of bookings (e.g., “15 Min Discovery Call”, “1 Hour Strategy Session”) each with their own unique duration and location.
  • Custom Availability: Set specific weekly schedules for each event type.
  • Modern Interface: A clean, responsive, multi-step booking process for your visitors.
  • Admin Dashboard: Manage all your “Booking Types” and view confirmed “Bookings” in one organized place.
  • Email Notifications: Automatic confirmation emails sent to both the visitor and the administrator.
  • Shortcode Driven: Display any booking type anywhere on your site using a simple shortcode: [booking-master id="EVENT_ID"].
sections.installation:
1. Upload the booking-master folder to the /wp-content/plugins/ directory.
  2. Activate the plugin through the ‘Plugins’ menu in WordPress.
  3. Go to the ‘Booking Types’ menu and create your first event.
  4. Copy the shortcode provided in the ‘Shortcode’ column and paste it onto any page or post.
sections.faq:
How do I find the Event ID for the shortcode?

Go to the ‘Booking Types’ screen. We’ve added a special ‘Shortcode’ column that shows you exactly what to copy and paste!

Can I have multiple booking forms on one page?

Yes! You can use multiple shortcodes with different IDs on the same page.

Where are the bookings stored?

All confirmed appointments are stored under the ‘Bookings’ submenu within the ‘Booking Types’ top-level menu.
